about_the_game:
The Empty King is waiting.

Welcome to the Realm, adventurer! In this quirky, cutesy world, you’ll gather, craft, fight while on your awesome quest to discover the secrets of the fabled necromancer god, The Empty King. But things can’t just be that simple…

Take advantage of all the weapons at your disposal - you'll need them!

Along the way, you'll have to think on your feet using staff, sword, and bow to fight mythical monsters and eldritch abominations. One moment you’re shooting arrows from afar, the next, you're slashing a zweihander against their skull! Switch up your gear, and even combat style, mid-fight to exploit openings in your foe’s defenses, all the while strategically using special attacks and abilities, known as rites of malice and rites of bulwark, to slay your foes, lest they slay you…

Mix-and-match classes to your advantage or stick with your favorite that suits your gameplay style.

Over 20 intertwined skills let you gather, craft, and wield powerful equipment to aid you in your quest. There’s the simple things - mine ores, smelt ores into bars, smith bars into swords, and wield the sword using your attack skill, but if you’re looking for a bit more complexity, perhaps use alchemy, engineering, and smithing to construct muskets and ammo to blast enemies to smithereens from afar using archery and dexterity! The combinations are endless.

Deep crafting trees and resource gathering action commands are just the tip of the iceberg.

Explore dangerous dungeons, foggy forests, ancient ruins, claustrophobic catacombs, the open sea, and other fantastic (or foreboding!) corners of the Realm. Yet, there might be more to reality than just those pesky two-and-a-half dimensions…

An incredible world awaits you.

Help a bunch of like-minded adventurers (cough, NPCs, cough) achieve their own victories! Decisions must be made during your adventure on who to help, who to fight, and who to betray; in a world full of cryptic cults and secret societies, where everyone has ulterior motivations, things might not be so simple. Think wisely, or you might just be alone when you face The Empty King!

Start your quest in the Realm, adventurer. Only you can end the Age of Fate and make the world anew in the Age of Chaos!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5 7xxx series or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 1060 or equivalent
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i7 8xxx series or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 3060 or equivalent
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 14
  • Processor: Apple M2 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: ItsyRealm currently requires lower graphics settings on macOS.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 14
  • Processor: Apple M4 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: ItsyRealm currently requires lower graphics settings on macOS.

short_description: A quirky RPG borne by chaos. Smith in the belly of a gored dragon! Fight a spider-tree! Mine a glyph beast to death! Switch up gear and classes in the heat of battle to fell foes. Make choices, cause mayhem, but beware: timing matters. Who will avail you when confronting The Empty King?
